description: Efterpi Paraskevoulakou publishes synthetic monitoring metrics for the CODECO edge-cloud orchestration platform. Zenodo provides a four-node workload CSV free under CC BY 4.0. Custom functions imitate node infrastructure, data governance and overlay/underlay network metrics, collected through a Kubernetes environment. Each row represents a node at a timestamp. These generated time series can benchmark orchestration, anomaly-detection or resource-allocation components in infrastructure simulation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this synthetic release. The dataset is not a measurement of production cloud performance, despite collection through a real cluster interface. Simulated duration, sampling interval, column units and exact generator settings are not established by the landing description. Transfer to operational workloads and failure conditions remains uncertain. No CSV was downloaded, generator executed or claimed realism independently evaluated.
